messages:
jamal: Quick Q — my RB (D. Johnson) tweaked his hammy in practice. 2-team keeper, playoffs next week. Anyone up for a last-minute swap? :grimacing:

lina: Oof, brutal. Who are you offering? Waivers look thin this week.

jamal: Offering my late-round pick + bench player. Roster at a glance: `QB: T. Lawrence, RBs: D. Johnson (iffy), K. Harris, WRs: M. Smith, R. Woods, TE: G. Kittle` — ideally want a steady RB or a PPR handcuff.

alex: Can negotiate. Also unrelated but important: poll — Friday night Spurs watch party in the kitchen? Pizza and a whiteboard for fantasy trades? :pizza: :white_large_square:

tanya: Jamal — I have an extra RB (K. Elliot-type, low floor but decent touches). I can swap straight up for K. Harris if commish signs off. Also yes to pizza.

jamal: @tanya that would be clutch. I'll take the trade if the app shows it. Commish usually sleeps through this stuff though. :zzz:

ops-bot: Calendar update: Kitchen reserved Fri 6:45pm–9:15pm for "Spurs Watch / Fantasy Swap". Please clean up after yourselves.

lina: If commish is on vacation, i'll do the ancient admin ritual: `/trade-appeal --approve jamal tanya` (kidding). :joy:

alex: For fairness let's do a quick mock matchup after the trade to confirm. Jamal, can you post who you'd bench if you take the RB?

jamal: I'd bench K. Harris or maybe R. Woods depending on matchup — lean Harris.

tanya: Sent trade. It's pending. Jamal, accept when you can. Good luck in the rest of the playoffs — may the waiver gods be merciful. :pray:

jamal: Accepted. Huge thanks @tanya — beers on me at the watch party. :beer:

lina: Congrats — now back to pretending my bench matters. :sob:
